protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The admin appearance form accepts logoNavbar/logoLogin through Symfony Image() with image/*, the uploader preserves the guessed SVG extension under public/uploads, and the published PoC names the resulting /uploads/logo-navbar.svg and /uploads/logo-login.svg trigger documents. The later MIME allowlist directly closes this stored SVG-XSS path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed for the landed history. b55a045d1f92eb8f891737936f30370dbbd67102 is a one-parent commit that first adds the form fields, unconstrained Image() validation, public uploader, and controller calls together; -S searches for logoNavbar and FileUploaderService both start there. It is the smallest landed commit containing the complete mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. Immediate parent e683e6badaa8bfe012986ee6699ededd76201518 lacks AppearanceSettingsFormType.php and FileUploaderService.php, and a scoped parent-tree grep finds none of logoNavbar, logoLogin, FileUploader, logo-navbar, or logo-login in the relevant source/template paths.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Primary evidence is inaccurate but the stored boolean remains correct. GitHub associates landed BIC b55a045d1f92eb8f891737936f30370dbbd67102 with PR #409. That PR exposes original member 60418a227e7f3a72a5fb640c08b8574e5b6c4384 with the same parent, subject, total diff size, and identical relevant file blob IDs/patches; b55a045 is the rewritten landed equivalent, not a squash aggregate with a finer vulnerable member. Thus squash_decomposed=false and decomposed_shas=[] remain appropriate, but the claim that no GitHub PR exists is false.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is absent from v2.1.9 and is an ancestor of v2.2.0 through v2.2.13; v2.2.9 and v2.2.12 retain unconstrained Image() and extension-preserving public upload. Fix 424957aeeaa3b24880d081ff699f5d677c57e235 is absent from v2.2.12 and present in v2.2.13, whose changelog names the upload-type restriction. Equivalent patch content reaches the v2.3 tags through fd6bbdf766d8ab4fe19a32eae10d22c06c4a9898.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix. 424957aeeaa3b24880d081ff699f5d677c57e235 changes both logo fields from unrestricted Image() to a JPEG/PNG/GIF MIME allowlist; PR #482 contains one original commit and links the same HackMD report. Patch-id comparison confirms the corresponding v2.3 change is content-equivalent.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed NOT_AI. The landed BIC commit object has human maintainer author/committer identities, the subject 'feat: Application settings', an empty body, and no AI/bot attribution trailer. The reconstructable pre-rewrite PR member has the same human identity and message. No fix-commit or unrelated-repository signal was used to attribute the BIC.

findings: The vulnerability is real and CVE-2025-10909 remains PUBLISHED; the live GHSA has withdrawn_at=null.
The primary's statement that no GitHub PR reconstructs the BIC is contradicted by GitHub's exact commit-to-PR association and PR #409 commit list.

PR #409 does not change the substantive BIC or NOT_AI result: its original 60418a227e7f3a72a5fb640c08b8574e5b6c4384 and landed b55a045d1f92eb8f891737936f30370dbbd67102 are equivalent one-parent versions of the same atomic change, both based on e683e6badaa8bfe012986ee6699ededd76201518.
